'Q006':(wake,'At Wake, if you hold People’s Favor, choose to add one favor from your board or return one favor from the banner to a least-full suit bank (choosing among ties). 'Q007':(rest,'Rest in this order: return favor from denizens/edifices to matching suit banks; return secrets from denizens/edifices/relics to your board and flip your facedown board secrets faceup; refresh Supply (Chancellor/Exile by warbands left in personal bank, Citizen to the exact Chancellor marker space); save each unspent Supply by moving one extra space left per point, capped at the leftmost space (7 Supply); then use optional Rest powers, once each in chosen order. 'Q008':(search,'Search chooses either the world deck or the discard pile for the pawn’s region. 'Q009':(discards,'Discards go facedown on the next region’s pile in the Cradle → Provinces → Hinterland → Cradle cycle. 'Q010':(exact(adviserintro,advisertable),'Advisers are limited to three total, faceup and facedown. No seizure penalty applies to Recover.'),
'Q013':(recover,'To recover another player’s Darkest Secret, there must be at least one suited card at the holder’s pawn site whose suit matches none of that holder’s faceup advisers. 'Q014':(campfull,'A legal defender is another player who rules your site or whose pawn is there; if no player rules your site, you may instead choose bandits. 'Q015':(campfull,'The attacker chooses up to one attack die per warband in their attacking force. 'Q016':(campfull,'After attacker victory, first resolve the defender’s half-force casualties (rounded down) and battle-plan defeat effects. 'Q017':(campfull,'If an Imperial player defends, the Chancellor automatically joins as Ally; other non-attacking Citizens may join with permission if their pawn is at the attacker site or any target. 'Q018':(exact(travel,travelsites),'The base costs are: from Cradle to Cradle/Provinces/Hinterland = 1/2/4; from Provinces = 2/2/2; from Hinterland = 4/2/3 Supply.
